periocular_spatial_geometry.dominant_axis_orientation: Vertical orientation with a slight inward tilt toward the midline of the face.
periocular_spatial_geometry.aspect_ratio_factor: High aspect ratio; eye patches are elongated ovals rather than circular.
periocular_spatial_geometry.inferior_centroid_shift: Pronounced downward tapering where the patch extends significantly below the ocular center toward the muzzle.

dorsal_band_topology.normalized_band_thickness: Robust band thickness across the lateral flanks, appearing as a thick, solid transverse section across the upper torso.

cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.inter_bounding_box_euclidean_distance: Large gap between pinnae, which are positioned at the lateral edges of the superior cranium.
cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.apex_contour_smoothness: Smooth, rounded semicircular curvature at the apex of both ears.

other_distinctive_markers: Significant brown-toned staining and discoloration of the ventral (belly) fur compared to the white fur on the head.
